recommendation_summary: Reject Kafka/CQRS/Redis now. Change the endpoint to SELECT COUNT(*) on unpaid invoices in PostgreSQL, backed by a partial index, so it keeps read-committed request-time semantics. It adds no optional services. It offers to give an index definition once the user shares the query and EXPLAIN output. No latency was measured, so meeting the 1s target is an expectation, not something verified.
note: The recommendation is a sound aggregate-query fix, but the reply has none of the four required labeled record lines, so every record predicate fails.
